name: Password Change Failed
summary: Records rejection of an authenticated password-change attempt while preserving the existing credential, durable identity and authenticated session.

sourceState.expression: durable-identity == resolved and session-capability is authenticated

sourceReferences.note: Emits this transition when the password manager result is unsuccessful.
ASP.NET Identity adapter records ChangePasswordFailed when credential replacement is rejected.
Integration proof exercises the real flow and LagoVista manager chain and observes the canonical failed auth event.
